steps: EXCLUDE cardiac cause first if any doubt.
Lifestyle: weight loss, smaller meals, avoid late meals/triggers, elevate head of bed.
Endoscopy if alarm features (dysphagia, weight loss, anaemia, age/onset).
Step down to lowest effective therapy.

drugRefs.duration: 4–8 weeks, then step down to lowest effective dose
drugRefs.why: Empirical PPI trial is first-line for typical reflux symptoms once cardiac causes are excluded; suppresses gastric acid and heals reflux oesophagitis.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
ACG Clinical Guideline — Diagnosis and Management of GERD (2022)
NICE CG184 — Gastro-oesophageal Reflux Disease and Dyspepsia in Adults

decision.label: PPI trial after excluding cardiac cause

confirm: Burning retrosternal pain, postprandial/positional, acid regurgitation — once cardiac causes are excluded.
